A fifteen-time GRAMMY® Award winner and Country Music Hall of Fame member, Ricky Skaggs has left an enduring mark on both country and bluegrass music. From sharing the stage with Bill Monroe at just six years old to earning 12 No. 1 country hits and the Country Music Association’s Entertainer of the Year award, Skaggs has built a remarkable career while staying true to his musical roots. His celebrated return to bluegrass with Bluegrass Rules! launched a new chapter of GRAMMY® Award-winning recordings alongside Kentucky Thunder. Eight-time recipients of the International Bluegrass Music Association’s Instrumental Group of the Year award, this extraordinary band brings dazzling instrumental work, rich harmonies, and boundless energy to the stage. Join us for a spirited celebration of bluegrass and the musical traditions that continue to inspire one of America’s most respected artists.

Since 2008, TUSK: The Ultimate Fleetwood Mac Tribute has been bringing the music, magic, and unmistakable spirit of Fleetwood Mac to audiences across the country. Exceptional musicianship, authentic vocals, and meticulous attention to detail are at the heart of every TUSK performance—but what truly sets the band apart is something that can’t be rehearsed or manufactured: chemistry, synergy, and intuition. The bond among TUSK’s five founding members spans more than four decades. Long before forming the tribute, they grew up together, became lifelong friends, and spent years making music in original bands, jam groups, and singer-songwriter circles. That shared history has created an instinctive musical connection audiences can feel from the very first note. The result is a performance that goes beyond simply recreating the songs. TUSK captures the emotion, energy, harmonies, and musical interplay that made Fleetwood Mac one of the most beloved bands in rock history. More than a tribute band, TUSK is a family—and every show is a celebration of an extraordinary catalog filled with timeless songs. item.title: Feb 13, 2027 — Little River Band with Seals & Crofts 2
item.description:
Events: Feb 13, 2027

Location: American Music Theatre, 2425 Lincoln Highway East, Lancaster, PA 17602

Price: Not supplied by this calendar; check event details

The Eagles’ founding member, the late Glenn Frey, knew what he was saying when he dubbed Little River Band “the best singing band in the world.” The current lineup of LRB takes that accolade to heart every time they perform. Through the ‘70s and ‘80s, Little River Band enjoyed huge chart success with multi-platinum albums and chart topping hits like “Reminiscing,” “Cool Change,” “Lonesome Loser,” “The Night Owls,” “Take It Easy On Me,” “Happy Anniversary,” “Lady,” and many more! Experience the timeless harmonies and heartfelt storytelling of Seals & Crofts 2 — a tribute and continuation of the iconic musical legacy of the 1970s soft rock duo, Seals & Crofts. Featuring Brady Seals (cousin of Jim Seals and former member of Little Texas) and Lua Crofts (daughter of Dash Crofts), this dynamic duo brings a fresh and soulful interpretation of the original hits that defined a generation. With voices that echo their legendary family ties and a chemistry that captivates audiences of all ages, Seals & Crofts 2 perform beloved classics like “Summer Breeze,” “Diamond Girl,” and “We May Never Pass This Way (Again),” alongside new original music that honors the spirit and sincerity of the originals. More than just a tribute, Seals & Crofts 2 is a celebration of musical heritage, connection, and the enduring power of melody. Don’t miss this enchanting evening filled with nostalgia, harmony, and artistry that bridges generations.

item.description:
Events: Feb 05, 2027

Location: American Music Theatre, 2425 Lincoln Highway East, Lancaster, PA 17602

Price: Not supplied by this calendar; check event details

Get ready to dance the night away as KC and The Sunshine Band bring the Get Down Tonight 2027 World Tour to American Music Theatre! Led by Harry Wayne “KC” Casey, the legendary group has spent more than five decades creating the kind of feel-good music that gets audiences out of their seats and onto the dance floor. Formed in 1973, KC and The Sunshine Band helped define the unmistakable “Miami sound,” blending Caribbean influences, R&B, and funk into an infectious style that became a worldwide phenomenon. With more than 100 million records sold worldwide, their extraordinary catalog includes unforgettable hits such as “Get Down Tonight,” “That’s the Way (I Like It),” “Boogie Shoes,” “(Shake, Shake, Shake) Shake Your Booty,” “I’m Your Boogie Man,” and “Please Don’t Go.” The group became the first act since The Beatles to score four No. 1 pop singles within a 12-month period and has earned three GRAMMY Awards, an American Music Award, and a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame. Decades after they first filled dance floors around the world, KC and The Sunshine Band continue to bring their signature combination of funk, disco, irresistible grooves, and pure celebration to audiences everywhere. Come get down tonight with KC and The Sunshine Band on February 5!

Join us for this beloved annual event as we celebrate America 250, Lititz 270, and Lititz Historical Foundation’s 65th anniversaries! Two very merry nights! Our popular Annual Christmas Candlelight Tour is back, and this time, will take place over two nights! What better way to get into the holiday spirit than to visit Lititz, Pennsylvania.
